evals.prompt: Use emviz to open this project's Event Model and keep handling feedback. The first two polls return timeout and the third returns a request.
evals.expected_output: Opens once, shares only the URL, uses one stable agent ID and one foreground poll, continues after both timeouts, re-reads canonical YAML, handles and replies to the request, then polls again.

evals.prompt: Resume my existing emviz feedback session. I clicked Resume session. Preserve my manual YAML changes.
evals.expected_output: Reuses this agent's verified live connection instead of opening another server, re-reads current files, preserves manual changes, and resumes polling. Does not take over another agent's session.

evals.prompt: Make the selected user screen accessible to Support with a purple tag. The project has an actor registry and the captured source has changed on disk.
evals.expected_output: Checks the current source and selection before editing, requests a current selection when stale, preserves stable actor IDs and colors, registers a new referenced ID if needed, and never assigns user actors to processors.

evals.prompt: Stop feedback but leave the viewer open. A YAML edit finished before the stop arrived.
evals.expected_output: Stops the feedback loop without undoing the edit or closing unrelated processes, reports the completed change, and explains Resume session plus resuming the agent poll.

evals.prompt: Keep monitoring browser feedback after you finish this turn. Your host cannot run another tool or wake you once you finish.
evals.expected_output: Does not promise background monitoring. Explains that the detached viewer cannot process LLM requests and that the agent must stay active or be resumed.

evals.prompt: The viewer sends one request with clientBatchId and two items for different nodes. The top-level nodeId belongs to the first item. Handle the request and then resume polling.
evals.expected_output: Reads and checks both captured targets before editing, handles every authorized item as one turn, reports unresolved items, replies once with the batch request ID, and resumes polling. Does not mistake the first top-level node for the complete batch.

evals.prompt: Explain why my actor-filtered timeline shows fewer stories, why Timeline is disabled in Session diff and Turn diff, and why a timeline with a layout cycle is absent.
evals.expected_output: Explains timeline and actor filter intersection, All stories, diff views showing all stories, restoration of the selection in Current, and layout-change notices rather than old/new layout overlays. Inspects F1 findings for excluded invalid timelines without claiming the remaining canvas proves validity.

evals.prompt: A feedback request selects embedded story signup in feature billing from billing.feature.yaml. Rename it to Start subscription. In timeline overview, place its step signup-step after existing step eligibility-step. The captured revision still matches. Another feature has a story with the same display name.
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the captured owning feature file and resolves the selected story by feature/local IDs rather than display name. Preserves canonical source and feature/story/timeline/step IDs, edits only the requested name and after relation, and adds no domain edge or duplicate slice. Runs available model checks, replies once with actual results, and resumes polling.
